# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows

# Display basic info
sales_df.info()

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the date range
print("\nDate range:", sales_df['date'].min(), "to", sales_df['date'].max())

# Check for any obvious campaign indicators in the data
print("\nUnique campaign identifiers:", sales_df['campaign'].unique())"}
